insurance_24_seeds.pipeline_architecture_note: Controlled retrieval + symbolic rule-decision pipelines: pure BGE-small-zh-v1.5 dense retrieval (100% vector cache coverage, zero lexical fallback) or BM25 char-2 retrieval on query text followed by isolated `predict(question, retrieved_clause, inference_config)` symbolic rule variants.

retrieval_backend_audit.dense_backend: BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5 (exact L2-normalized CLS cosine similarity, lexical fallback on cache miss disabled)
retrieval_backend_audit.lexical_zero_overlap_guard: if max(bm25_char2_scores) <= 0.0: return None (rejects zero-overlap out-of-domain strings before BGE cosine lookup)
